messages:
Maya (Design): Pushed a tiny responsive update for the console list. Main asks: confirm sidebar collapse point, table-cell ellipsis behavior, and the new floating sort pill UX on narrow screens. Pls test on phones and flag a11y/copy issues. :mag:
Samir (Product): Quick preference: keep a compact, 2-line table variant between 460-520px so power users keep density. Only flip to stacked cards at <=400px. Also change header text to "Filter results" (for clarity).
Elaine (Frontend): Prototype currently: table->compact rows @ 500px, compact->cards @ 400px. CSS snippet: `@media (max-width:500px){.row--compact{height:56px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}} @media (max-width:400px){.results-table{display:none}.cards{display:block}}`
Nora (A11y): If we change DOM from table->list, ensure `role="list"` + `role="listitem"` for cards and expose heading links so screen reader users can jump. Announce sheet open/close with `aria-live="polite"`. Close button needs `aria-label="Close filters"`.
Jon (PM): Add analytics hooks: `ui.layout_change` with layout id, and `ui.keyboard_present_on_submit` when keyboard was visible. Also sticky sort pill should be labelled "Sort by" for SR users.
Elaine (Frontend): iOS keyboard note: when an input in the filter sheet is focused the bottom action gets obscured. Plan: watch `visualViewport` and toggle `.keyboard-open` to increase bottom padding and translate the sheet up. Will debounce resize so we don't flip layout mid-scroll.
Maya (Design): I'll update figma with compact-row specs, sticky pill spacing, and copy changes: https://www.figma.com/file/abcd/mobile-console-responsive. Add QA checklist in ticket INF-1350.
Samir (Product): I'll test on iPhone SE and Pixel 6 and post screenshots. If no regressions, we land compact rows at 500->480 decision next week.
DeployBot: staging preview: https://staging.redwood.internal/responsive-console-1950 (build 2026.03.25-02) :rocket:
Elaine (Frontend): Opening a small PR with debounce, keyboard handling, chip role updates, and instrumentation. Will include ellipsis rules for compressed rows and ensure focus persistence when returning from a detail view.
